data.name: Tarunraj
data.long_meaning:
The name Tarunraj is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Tarun’ meaning young, youthful and ‘Raj’ meaning king.
This name is often given to a boy who is believed to bring radiance and prosperity to the family.
Tarunraj is also associated with the Hindu deity Indra, the king of gods, who is known for his youthful and energetic nature.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the youthful energy and radiance of the Hindu god Indra.
data.numerology_meaning: People with this number are diplomats, peacekeepers, and mediators.
